ruleDefinitions.name: ESXi VM List Discovery Via ESXCLI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "vm" flag in order to retrieve information about the installed VMs.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/esxcli$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*vm\\ process.*") AND process_command_line = RGX("\\ list$"))
